title: a stride was computed from the default LUT size before the file could lower it
object: lut3d->lut, one av_malloc_array of lutsize^3 entries
lifetime_ender: NONE -- the buffer is alive throughout. SPATIAL row.
shape: a stride computed before the directive that changes the size it is derived from
allocator_layer: the platform allocator itself: one direct av_malloc-family allocation, no inner layer. FFmpeg's av_malloc is malloc plus alignment.
fidelity: model consumer, real arithmetic: the sizes and the crossing expression are upstream's, quoted in PROVENANCE.md.
live_proof: absent at the pin: n9.0.1:libavfilter/vf_lut3d.c computes `size2` AFTER the 3DLUTSIZE block. The form computing it immediately after `lut3d->lutsize = size = 33;` is at 989444060d5f^ and is absent from the pin.

cheribsd-revocation.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-08, results/2026-10-08-cheribsd/: **CAUGHT.** signal=34, si_code=1 (the BOUNDS code), fault at 0x1021b6, with supervise resolving `expect ffh_write_probe_u8 0x10219e` from the ELF independently of the run -- the fault lies inside the probe's extent, the offset being the -O0 frame setup, and the RANGE is the attribution criterion rather than equality with the symbol address. The crossing leaves the allocator's USABLE size, which is what malloc bounds the capability to, so there is no size-class slack for it to hide in. tools/size-class-audit.py predicted this reading from the measured request size alone, and the two agree.

status: built 2026-10-08; native arms measured by runners/run-native.sh in the same commit. The platform arms are declared predictions.
nested_why: the crossed buffer came straight from av_malloc / av_mallocz / av_calloc / av_malloc_array -- which on the platform is malloc -- with no AVBufferPool or AVRefStructPool between it and the request. So under this inventory's axis, WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT, this row is NOT nested.
distinguishing: the index and the allocation are each internally consistent -- they simply come from DIFFERENT values of `size`, one read before the 3DLUTSIZE line and one after. That is why the fix moves a statement rather than changing an expression, and why a smaller declared size makes the crossing larger.
